rules: gw_pre
ct direction reply ct mark and 0xffff != 0x0 meta mark set meta mark or 0x10000
iifname "lo" return
iifname "kgw-*" ip saddr != @gw_nets drop
iifname "kgw-*" fib saddr . iif oif missing drop
ip saddr 10.77.1.0/24 iifname != "kgw-wg" drop
ip saddr 10.77.3.0/24 iifname != "kgw-awg2" drop
ip daddr @gw_nets iifname != "kgw-*" meta ipsec missing drop
ip saddr != @gw_nets return
ip daddr 10.77.0.1 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 53 ct mark set ct mark or 0x4b000000 return
ip daddr 10.77.0.1 icmp type echo-request ct mark set ct mark or 0x4b000000 return
ip saddr != @gw_live drop
fib daddr type local meta mark set 0x202 ct mark set ct mark or 0x202 return
ip daddr @gw_nets return
ct state established,related ct mark and 0xffff == 0x200 meta l4proto udp meta mark set 0x200 tproxy to 127.0.0.1:12345 accept
ct state established,related ct mark and 0xffff == 0x301 meta l4proto udp meta mark set 0x301 tproxy to 127.0.0.1:12401 accept
ct state established,related meta mark set ct mark and 0xffff return
meta mark set 0x2ff
meta mark set ip saddr map @gw_route
ip saddr @gw_rd ip daddr . meta l4proto @gw_ru ip daddr != @gw_force meta mark != 0x2ff meta mark set 0x201
ip saddr @gw_rd ip daddr @gw_ru_dns ip daddr != @gw_force meta mark != 0x2ff meta mark set 0x201
ct mark set meta mark or 0x4b000000
meta mark 0x200 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } tproxy to 127.0.0.1:12345
meta mark 0x301 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } tproxy to 127.0.0.1:12401
gw_fwd
ip saddr @gw_nets meta mark 0x2ff drop
ip saddr @gw_nets ct mark and 0xffff == 0x2ff drop
ip saddr @gw_nets ct mark and 0xffff == 0x200 drop
ip saddr @gw_nets ct mark and 0xff00 == 0x300 drop
ip saddr @gw_nets ct mark and 0xff00 == 0x100 oifname != "kawg*" drop
ip saddr @gw_nets ip daddr != @gw_nets ct mark and 0xffff == 0x0 drop
ip daddr 10.77.0.1 drop
ip saddr @gw_nets ip daddr @gw_nets drop
ip saddr @gw_nets ip daddr @gw_priv ct mark and 0xffff != 0x202 drop
ip saddr @gw_nets tcp flags syn tcp option maxseg size set rt mtu
iifname "kgw-wg" tcp flags syn tcp option maxseg size > 1240 tcp option maxseg size set 1240
oifname "kgw-wg" tcp flags syn tcp option maxseg size > 1240 tcp option maxseg size set 1240
iifname "kgw-awg2" tcp flags syn tcp option maxseg size > 1240 tcp option maxseg size set 1240
oifname "kgw-awg2" tcp flags syn tcp option maxseg size > 1240 tcp option maxseg size set 1240
iifname "kawg*" tcp flags syn tcp option maxseg size > 1192 tcp option maxseg size set 1192
oifname "kawg*" tcp flags syn tcp option maxseg size > 1192 tcp option maxseg size set 1192
gw_out
meta mark and 0xffffff00 == 0x100 oifname != "kawg*" drop
meta skuid 990 ip daddr 127.0.0.0/8 ct direction original meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport != 53 drop
gw_post
ip saddr @gw_nets oifname != "lo" ip daddr != @gw_nets masquerade
gw_dns
ip saddr @gw_nets ip daddr 10.77.0.1 udp dport 53 dnat to 10.77.0.1:5354
ip saddr @gw_nets ip daddr 10.77.0.1 tcp dport 53 dnat to 10.77.0.1:5354
